name: Reruns of Tomorrow: Celmak's Mistakes (d8)
description: Roll each time someone looks closely at Absalom Station. Calling out a mistake (free action, once per round) makes one Hard-Light Actor glitch: staggered 1 round, no fast healing until the end of its next turn.

results.description:
Celmak shows: The Drift is a glowing river running through the Ring, with ships sailing on it.

The truth: The Drift is a separate plane, reached only by a ship's Drift engine.
